title: AI-based intelligent sensing detection of cybersecurity threats using multimodal sensor data in smart devices.
summary: CNN-RNN-Transformer models classify smart-device cybersecurity threats from controlled/public multimodal sensor datasets; the reported model reaches AUC 0.96 and 23 ms edge inference. This is a specific device-threat detection evaluation; rationale omits operational details and makes no real deployment claim.
